text:
Olivia: Quick sync — need final copy for our mode pages (hosted, dedicated, private) before Monday launch. Can we lock hero lines and CTAs today?
Sam: On it. Do we keep separate hero messaging or unify under single platform thesis?
Jordan: Recommend separate hero hooks. Hosted = fast to ship, Dedicated = predictable at scale, Private = compliance + VPC. Short lines only.
Rashmi: Agreed. Also need inbound lead routing changes: hosted → self-serve signups, dedicated → contact sales, private → sales + security intake.
Olivia: Good. Drafts: Hosted hero: "Ship LLM features today — hosted API with instant scale." Dedicated hero: "Predictable LLM throughput for production apps." Private hero: "Control and compliance for regulated workloads."
Sam: Nice. Can we tighten Hosted to "Ship LLM features in hours — managed inference, instant scale."?
Jordan: Love it. CTA mapping: hosted -> "Get started", dedicated -> "Request capacity", private -> "Talk to security". Use route params like `/signup?mode=hosted`, `/contact?flow=dedicated`, `/enterprise?intake=private`.
Rashmi: For benchmarks blurb, add: "Latency p95 < 50ms on common models — see benchmarks." Link to benchmark page and a CTA "See benchmarks". Keep the claim tight and footnoted.
Olivia: Tone: pragmatic, engineering-first. Avoid marketing fluff like "revolutionize". Use evidence points: SLAs, quantization recommendations, autoscaling policies.
Sam: Webinar plug — add a short line under each page: "Join our launch webinar — Wed, 11am PT. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar". Keep it subtle, not a hero.
Jordan: Also need an alternate hero variant for mobile (2 lines max).
Rashmi: I'll push copy edits to the Figma doc and run quick A/B: hero variant A (time-to-value) vs B (cost/perf).
Olivia: Also routing notes for inbound leads: add hidden form param `origin=mode-page` so we can track signups by page.
Sam: Will add tracking and update GA events. Quick example for devs: `fetch('/signup?mode=hosted&origin=mode-page')`.
mktg-bot: Draft published to /figma/redwood-mode-pages/v3 — 1719504321
Sam: :thumbsup:
Olivia: Thanks team — target to freeze copy by 4pm today. @Rashmi @Sam @Jordan please add final edits inline.
